idea_summary: A production-grade multi-tenant subscription SaaS platform enabling organizations to manage workspaces, invite members with time-limited invitations, enforce granular role-based access control, and process idempotent subscription billing operations securely.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall enforce strict multi-tenant data isolation by associating every organization workspace and nested entity with a verified Tenant ID.
acceptance_criteria: All workspace database queries filter strictly by tenant_id
Cross-tenant entity queries return HTTP 403 or 404

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall provide workspace role-based authorization supporting Owner, Admin, and Member roles with granular permission checks.
acceptance_criteria: Role permissions evaluated on every protected operation
Unauthorized role mutations return HTTP 403 Forbidden

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall generate time-bounded workspace invitations that expire automatically after a configurable TTL (default 7 days).
acceptance_criteria: Invitations past TTL return HTTP 410 Gone on acceptance attempt
Expired invitations are marked as EXPIRED

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall process billing provider webhooks idempotently using unique event IDs and transactional state handling.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate webhook deliveries return HTTP 200 without duplicate billing mutations
Webhook event record written prior to state update

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow workspace owners to manage subscription tiers, view invoices, and update payment details.
acceptance_criteria: Subscription state syncs with external payment gateway within 5 seconds
Invoices are accessible only to organization owners and billing admins

non_functional_requirements.statement: API Gateway rate limiting must protect workspace endpoints from denial of service and brute force.
non_functional_requirements.target: 100 requests per minute per IP for public endpoints; 1000 requests per minute per tenant for authenticated endpoints
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Automated load test executing bursts of 150 requests/min verifying HTTP 429 responses

non_functional_requirements.statement: API response latency for core workspace operations under nominal load.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Distributed performance testing using k6 benchmark suite

non_functional_requirements.statement: Data at rest and in transit must be encrypted with industry-standard cryptographic algorithms.
non_functional_requirements.target: AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Automated vulnerability scans and cryptographic configuration audit

architecture_components.name: API Gateway & Rate Limiter
responsibilities: Enforces IP and tenant token rate limits
Validates JWT authenticity and extracts tenant context

architecture_components.name: Authentication & Authorization Service
responsibilities: Enforces Workspace Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) policies

architecture_components.name: Workspace & Membership Service
responsibilities: Handles member invitations with expiration validation

architecture_components.name: Billing & Webhook Ingestion Service
responsibilities: Maintains subscription statuses and billing audit logs
Communicates with external payment providers (e.g. Stripe)

data_entities.name: Organization
data_entities.purpose: Represents the top-level tenant entity containing workspaces, subscriptions, and memberships.

data_entities.name: Workspace
data_entities.purpose: Represents a tenant-isolated project area within an organization.

data_entities.name: Membership
data_entities.purpose: Maps users to workspaces and defines their role (Owner, Admin, Member).

data_entities.name: WorkspaceInvitation
data_entities.purpose: Stores invite tokens, target email addresses, roles, and expiration timestamps.

data_entities.name: Subscription
data_entities.purpose: Tracks billing tier, active status, customer ID, and renewal dates.

data_entities.name: WebhookEventLog
data_entities.purpose: Stores processed payment provider event IDs to guarantee idempotent webhook execution.

api_operations.purpose: Creates a new organization tenant and initial workspace
Invites a new member to a workspace with role and expiration TTL
Accepts an invitation to join a workspace before expiration
Retrieves tenant-isolated resources belonging to a workspace
Receives and processes payment gateway webhooks idempotently

tests.description: Verify that User from Tenant A cannot access resources in Workspace belonging to Tenant B (Cross-Tenant Access Test) returning HTTP 403/404.
Verify that a Member role cannot create workspace invitations, failing with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
Verify that accepting an invitation past its expiration timestamp returns HTTP 410 Gone.
Verify that sending identical billing webhook events twice processes business logic once and returns HTTP 200 on both requests.
Execute 1000 concurrent GET requests on workspace resources to ensure p95 latency remains under 120ms.
Verify that exceeding 100 requests per minute from a single IP to public endpoints results in HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

obligation_coverage.design_response: Every database query is tenant-scoped using tenant_id foreign keys and RLS (Row Level Security). COMP-1 and COMP-2 enforce tenant validation on every request.
COMP-2 evaluates roles (Owner, Admin, Member) on all mutating and sensitive operations. API endpoints validate RBAC scopes.
COMP-3 validates invitation token expiration timestamps against current system time, rejecting expired tokens with HTTP 410.
COMP-4 stores unique webhook transaction IDs in ENT-6 (WebhookEventLog) in a database transaction to ignore duplicate events gracefully.
Explicit security integration test TEST-1 exercises tenant boundary penetration and confirms unauthorized cross-tenant requests are denied.

assumptions.statement: External billing provider supports HMAC signature headers for authenticating incoming webhook requests.
Default invitation expiration is set to 7 days, which satisfies standard organizational security policies.
Single relational database with Row Level Security is sufficient for initial tenant data isolation scale before migrating to separate tenant schemas.
